label: Small Business & Client Service Portal (Staff + Client PermSets)
summary: Bright, welcoming studio & service business template where Staff post project deliverables and Clients review and approve milestones.
defaultGoal: Give staff and clients a shared, zero-PII project and service portal where deliverables, status updates, and service requests are organized by Client / Project Code.
defaultFeatures: Public service showcase with business hours, service menu, and client onboarding call-to-action
Staff PermSet workspace to post deliverables, service milestones, and scheduling updates
Client PermSet portal scoped by Client / Project Code to review work and submit requests
Isolated MongoDB persistence for project timelines and client approvals

defaultRoles.purpose: Post project deliverables, service updates, and client milestones.
View project deliverables, approve milestones, and submit service requests.

templateQuestions.label: 1. What services or packages does your business offer?
templateQuestions.placeholder: e.g. Custom Remodeling, Design Consultations, Maintenance Plans
templateQuestions.hint: Displayed as featured service cards on your public landing page.
templateQuestions.defaultValue:
Initial Consultation & Space Planning — Tailored blueprint & project scope
Custom Project Delivery & Milestones — Dedicated weekly progress updates
Ongoing Support & Priority Care — Year-round maintenance & client support

templateQuestions.label: 2. Business Hours & Service Area / Location
templateQuestions.placeholder: e.g. Mon–Fri 8am–6pm CT · Serving Twin Cities & Remote Clients
templateQuestions.hint: Shown in the public contact & availability strip.
templateQuestions.defaultValue: Mon–Fri 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM · Serving Local & Remote Clients

templateQuestions.label: 3. Primary Call-to-Action & Welcome Promise
templateQuestions.placeholder: e.g. Track your project milestones with 100% private client login
templateQuestions.hint: Highlighted in the hero banner above the login button.
templateQuestions.defaultValue: Track your project milestones, deliverables, and service requests with zero personal data exposure.

templateQuestions.label: 4. Member Workspace Categories (comma-separated)
templateQuestions.placeholder: e.g. Project Milestone, Estimate / Invoice, Client Request, Schedule Update
templateQuestions.hint: Populates the category options inside the protected /home workspace.
templateQuestions.defaultValue: Project Milestone, Deliverable Ready, Client Request, Schedule Update
